mapper.select: SELECT sc_id FROM tbl_sip_call WHERE sc_serial_number = #{notiSerial} AND sc_reg_date >= DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(#{notiTime}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), INTERVAL 10 SECOND) AND sc_reg_date <= DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{notiTime}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) ORDER BY COALESCE(ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, STR_TO_DATE(sc_start_date, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), STR_TO_DATE(#{notiTime}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'))), 2147483647) ASC, sc_reg_date ASC, sc_id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT sc_id, sc_dv_id, sc_serial_number, sc_start_date, sc_end_date, sc_duration, sc_status, sc_direction, sc_audio_path, sc_has_audio, sc_reg_date FROM tbl_sip_call WHERE sc_id = #{scId}
